A name used to clandestinely identify somebody or something, either for military or espionage purposes, or for commercial confidentiality.
A word relayed to a person to gain admittance to a place or to gain access to information.

examples.text: Only if a would-be visitor knew the password du jour could he pass; the guards allowed no exceptions.

glosses: A string of characters used to log in to a computer or network, to access a level in a video game, and so on; archetypally a word but nowadays often an alphanumeric string or a phrase.

examples.text: A strong password has a mixture of lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers, and punctuation marks.

glosses: To protect with a password.
Expression qui permet de désigner un mot, une phrase, un concept, une personne, une opération de manière concise, non ambiguë et confidentielle.
Mot utilisé pour obtenir l’accès à certaines informations ou à un certain lieu.
